summary: The KayKit stairs match the brief's prompt (grey stone steps between two side walls ending in square posts), and every budget, texture, hole and palette assertion passes; the only findings are minor.

findings.observation: Side walls are full-height sloped walls, not low; posts at the top end only.
Extra dark base slab around the bottom, part of the kit piece.
Small dark notch on one raised brick on the right wall, visible only up close.

questions_answered: Straight staircase, 8 treads, side walls and posts present (walls full-height).
15 parts, one loop each, none visible.
